_comment: TEST KEY ONLY. Generated for the Vouch API contract test vectors; it protects nothing. ECDSA signatures are randomised, so clients must check that their own signature VERIFIES against public_key, not that it equals signature_b64url. The pair case's body uses placeholders for the keys and the proof; it is hashed and signed exactly as written, placeholders included. Real pair bodies carry the device's own keys.
algorithm: ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256, DER-encoded signature, base64url without padding

cases.name: pair (signed with the new transport key)

decision_key_proof._comment: The decision key's proof at pairing, made here with the same test key. Real devices use two different keys.

shown_digest._comment: What the app displayed for a request, as hashed into the decision body. `canonical` is the exact string whose UTF-8 bytes are hashed; lengths are UTF-8 byte counts.
